title: Inference · P/D throughput, latency & caches
description: Reusable role/rank monitoring for vLLM and PrimeIntellect P/D routing.

panels.title: Live inference monitoring · 15-second scrape and refresh

options.content: 15-second scrape and refresh. Output throughput excludes prefill output tokens; per-GPU rates use the allocated GPU count. Select a role to inspect individual ranks. Monitoring follows the Slurm job and stops when it ends.

panels.title: Token throughput by role
panels.description: Input is actual local compute, excluding local/external KV hits. Output excludes the producer token. Each role counted once.

panels.title: Inter-token latency · live decode observations
panels.description: Token-weighted backend interval; histogram percentiles are bucket approximations.

panels.title: TPOT · completed requests
panels.description: Request-weighted average TPOT, published when requests finish.

panels.title: Backend time to first token
panels.description: Role-local TTFT. Decode TTFT includes KV import, but this is not client end-to-end TTFT.

panels.title: KV cache usage by rank
panels.description: vLLM logical KV allocator usage. With HiSparse, this does not equal physical GPU HBM utilization.

panels.title: Newly computed input throughput by rank
P/D transfer and CPU cache loading
NIXL receive throughput
panels.description: Transferred bytes from the NIXL histogram sum; roles shown separately to avoid double counting.

panels.title: HiSparse host → GPU reload throughput
panels.description: Five-minute average of delayed counters (~2,000 engine-step publication cadence). This does not measure instantaneous PCIe utilization or copy duration.

panels.title: Router handler duration · p50 / p95
panels.description: Router instrumentation duration, not a validated streaming client end-to-end latency.

panels.title: Transport / store failures in last 5 minutes
